newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - McMinnville, Ore..

text.p: General Obligation Bonds - Transportation Projects, Series
The City of McMinnville, Oregon intends to receive sealed bids for the above referenced series of General Obligation Bonds - Transportation Projects (the Bonds'') until 10:00 a.m., Pacific time on

at the offices of Gardiner &Clancy, 115 N.W. First Avenue, Suite 401, Portland, Oregon 97209. The Bonds will be dated October 1, 1996 and will mature in the approximate principal amounts set forth in the full Notice of Sale on December 1 of the years 1997 through 2006, inclusive. The City has reserved the right to adjust the aggregate principal amount maturing in each year based on the winning bid in order to achieve total principal and interest payments which will be substantially equal in each year. The winning bidder may designate one or more term bonds subject to mandatory redemption commencing in the year following the final serial maturity with the aggregate principal amount to be redeemed in each such year to be the same as the aggregate principal amounts set forth in the full Notice of Sale for each maturity. The Bonds are not subject to optional redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds will be issued in Book-Entry form only. Unless the City rejects any or all bids received, the Bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid offers the lowest true interest cost to the City. The full Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official
Statement and bid forms may be obtained from the offices of the City's financial advisor, Gardiner &Clancy, 115 N.W. First Avenue, Suite 401, Portland, Oregon 97209, (503) 221- 1126.
